gl_mapping_hint: Which two accounts each business event moves. Nothing in the system writes an account code, so pointing these at a real chart of accounts is a change here and nowhere else.
gl_entries_hint: What each event has actually posted, looked up by the document number it came from.
placeholder_notice: Every event starts pointed at a placeholder account so nothing is lost while the chart of accounts is being agreed. Re-point them here when finance signs off — no deployment is needed.

event_hints.GRN_COMPLETE: Stock arrives at the provisional rate on the receipt; the clearing account holds it until the supplier is billed.
event_hints.LANDED_COST_POST: Freight, duty and clearing lift what the stock is worth, against whoever is owed for them.
event_hints.ISSUE_TO_PRODUCTION: Material leaves the store for a cutting programme: out of stock, into work in progress.
event_hints.PURCHASE_RETURN: Goods go back out of the gate and the supplier is debited for them.
event_hints.ADVANCE_PAYMENT: Money paid to a mill before anything is delivered — owed back in goods.
event_hints.INVOICE_SETTLEMENT: A bill settled partly out of an advance already paid and partly from the bank.

no_entries: Nothing has been posted to the books yet.
